tutorial.welcome.en: Welcome, young leader. I am Sensei Hoshi. Our clan has found a hidden valley in the mountains. Let's build a village no rival can find.
tutorial.welcome.text: 欢迎你，年轻的族长。我是保志师父。我们的忍族在群山中找到了一处隐秘的山谷。来建一座敌人永远找不到的村庄吧。

tutorial.mint.collect.en: Your Coin Mint is striking Coins. When a coin floats over it, tap it, then Collect.
tutorial.mint.collect.text: 你的铸币坊正在铸造金币。当金币浮现在上方时，点一下它，然后点“收取”。

tutorial.mint.build.en: A clan runs on Coins. Tap Build and place a Coin Mint.
tutorial.mint.build.text: 忍族靠金币运转。点“建造”，放下一座铸币坊。

tutorial.keep.en: Now strengthen the Clan Keep: tap the castle, then Upgrade.
tutorial.keep.text: 现在来强化天守阁：点一下城堡，然后点“升级”。

tutorial.finishKeep.wait.en: Upgrades take time. The Keep is ready in {time}: come back then, or tap Finish now to use a little Jade.
tutorial.finishKeep.wait.text: 升级需要时间。天守阁将在 {time}后完成：到时再回来，或者点“立即完成”花一点翡翠。

tutorial.finishKeep.done.en: The Keep is ready. Well done!

tutorial.army.tower.en: Rival clans will raid us. Build a Kunai Tower next to the Keep (Build, then the Defense tab): it shoots any raider in range.
tutorial.army.tower.text: 敌对忍族会来突袭我们。在天守阁旁建一座苦无塔（“建造”，然后选“防御”标签）：它会射击射程内的任何突袭者。

tutorial.army.all.en: Build a Training Dojo, a Squad Courtyard and a Kunai Tower next to the Keep (Build: the Army tab, then the Defense tab).
tutorial.army.all.text: 在天守阁旁建造修行道场、集结庭院和苦无塔（“建造”：先选“军队”标签，再选“防御”标签）。

tutorial.train.en: Open the Army panel and train some Shinobi: fast blades that strike the nearest building.
tutorial.train.text: 打开军队面板，训练一些忍者：他们是攻击最近建筑的迅捷刀客。

tutorial.finishTrain.wait.en: Training takes time too: your warriors are ready in {time}. Wait, or tap Finish training to use a little Jade.
tutorial.finishTrain.wait.text: 训练也需要时间：你的战士将在 {time}后就绪。等一等，或者点“立即完成训练”花一点翡翠。

tutorial.raid.en: Your first raid. Tap Attack, look over the target, then Attack! On the battlefield I will show you one thing at a time: send your Shinobi in through a glowing point, then smoke them as they reach a tower: warriors inside the smoke can only be shot from close up.
tutorial.raid.text: 你的第一次突袭。点“进攻”，查看目标，然后点“进攻！”。在战场上我会一步一步教你：让忍者从发光的潜入点进去，在他们走到箭塔前时放烟雾弹：烟雾中的战士只能被近距离射中。

tutorial.end.en: Well fought. Upgrade the Training Dojo to unlock Saboteurs: they jam a defense for a few seconds. Jam first, then strike, and smoke your warriors where the fire is heaviest. Collect, upgrade, raid, and join an Alliance.
tutorial.end.text: 打得好。升级修行道场可以解锁破坏者：他们能干扰防御几秒钟。先干扰，再出击，在火力最猛的地方给战士放烟雾。收取、升级、突袭，然后加入一个同盟吧。

objective.raid.en: Your army is ready: raid a rival
objective.raid.text: 军队已就绪：去突袭敌人吧

objective.keep.en: Upgrade your Clan Keep to Lv {level}

objective.save.en: {need} more for {building} Lv {level}: collect or raid
objective.save.text: {building}升到 {level} 级还差 {need}：去收取或突袭

toast.raided.en: {n, plural, one {# player raided your village} other {# players raided your village}}. See the battle log.
toast.raided.text: {n, plural, other {有 # 名玩家突袭了你的村庄}}。请查看战斗记录。

sync.pending.en: {n, plural, one {# action waiting to send.} other {# actions waiting to send.}}
sync.pending.text: {n, plural, other {有 # 个操作等待发送。}}

sessions.signedOut.en: {n, plural, one {Signed out # other device.} other {Signed out # other devices.}}
sessions.signedOut.text: {n, plural, other {已退出其他 # 台设备。}}

battle.scoutSummary.en: {points, plural, one {# point} other {# points}} · {defenses, plural, one {# defense} other {# defenses}}
battle.scoutSummary.text: {points, plural, other {# 个潜入点}} · {defenses, plural, other {# 座防御}}

battle.pointAria.en: {defenses, plural, one {Point {label}: # defense covers its path} other {Point {label}: # defenses cover its path}}
battle.pointAria.text: {defenses, plural, other {潜入点 {label}：有 # 座防御覆盖其路线}}

battle.offscreen.en: Infiltration point {label}, {left} space left, is off screen: show it
battle.offscreen.text: 潜入点 {label}（剩余空间 {left}）在屏幕外：点此显示

calendar.about.en: One reward a day, the same for everyone, never random and never sold. Miss a day and nothing is lost: the next claim is the next day on the list. Day 28 gives a Keep look.
calendar.about.text: 每天一份奖励，人人相同，绝不随机，也绝不出售。漏掉一天也不会损失：下次领取的就是列表上的下一天。第 28 天奖励一款天守阁外观。

calendar.gotLook.en: A new Keep look is yours: Store → Looks.
calendar.gotLook.text: 你获得了一款新的天守阁外观：商店 → 外观。

daily.missed.en: {n, plural, one {You missed # day without a skip, so your streak moved back # step.} other {You missed # days without a skip, so your streak moved back # steps.}}
daily.missed.text: {n, plural, other {你漏掉了 # 天且没有补签，所以连续天数后退了 # 步。}}

store.restored.text: {n, plural, other {已恢复 # 笔购买。}}

stipend.left.en: {n, plural, one {# payment left} other {# payments left}}

pass.endsInDays.en: {n, plural, one {the season ends in # day} other {the season ends in # days}}
pass.endsInDays.text: {n, plural, other {赛季将在 # 天后结束}}

offers.noAge.en: Special offers appear only once you have told us your age (Settings → Account → Spending → Set age group).
offers.noAge.text: 只有在你告诉我们你的年龄后，才会出现特别优惠（设置 → 账号 → 消费 → 设置年龄段）。

offers.minor.en: Special offers do not pop up for players under 18. Everything in the Jade tab stays available within your spending limit.
offers.minor.text: 特别优惠不会向未满 18 岁的玩家弹出。在你的消费限额内，翡翠标签中的所有商品仍然可以购买。

army.readyN.en: {n, plural, one {Ready to attack · # warrior} other {Ready to attack · # warriors}}
army.readyN.text: {n, plural, other {可以进攻 · # 名战士}}

army.finishedN.en: {n, plural, one {# finished warrior} other {# finished warriors}}
army.finishedN.text: {n, plural, other {# 名已完成的战士}}

army.queued.text: {n, plural, other {已排队 # 名战士。}}

settings.languageNote.en: The game follows your device language when it can. More languages arrive as their translations are finished.
settings.languageNote.text: 游戏会尽量跟随你设备的语言。更多语言会在翻译完成后推出。

research.lanesFree.en: {n, plural, one {# research lane free.} other {# research lanes free.}}
research.lanesFree.text: {n, plural, other {有 # 条研究队列空闲。}}

stipend.claim.text: 忍族俸禄：领取 {jade} 翡翠

stipend.leftDaily.en: {n, plural, one {# payment left, one a day. A missed day is never lost.} other {# payments left, one a day. A missed day is never lost.}}
stipend.leftDaily.text: {n, plural, other {还剩 # 次发放，每天一次。漏掉的一天永远不会作废。}}

pass.value.en: ≈ {jade} Jade value · {tiers}/{total} tiers reachable · {days, plural, one {# day left} other {# days left}}
pass.value.text: ≈ 价值 {jade} 翡翠 · 可达 {tiers}/{total} 阶 · {days, plural, other {剩余 # 天}}

war.attacksLeft.en: {n, plural, one {# attack left.} other {# attacks left.}}

war.relay.en: · relay: {n, plural, one {# strike so far} other {# strikes so far}} ({stars} {pct}%, last by {by})
war.relay.text: · 接力：{n, plural, other {目前已出击 # 次}}（{stars} {pct}%，最后一次由 {by} 出击）

raid.endsAttacks.en: {n, plural, one {Ends in {time} · You have # attack left.} other {Ends in {time} · You have # attacks left.}}
raid.endsAttacks.text: {n, plural, other {{time}后结束 · 你还剩 # 次进攻。}}

unlocks.capped.en: {n, plural, one {higher levels for # building} other {higher levels for # buildings}}
unlocks.capped.text: {n, plural, other {# 座建筑的更高等级}}

player.summary.en: {n, plural, one {Clan Keep {keep} · # warrior · {honor} honor} other {Clan Keep {keep} · # warriors · {honor} honor}}
player.summary.text: {n, plural, other {天守阁 {keep} 级 · # 名战士 · {honor} 荣誉}}

purchase.refunded.en: {n, plural, one {The store refunded a purchase, so what it gave was taken back. Anything already spent shows as a negative balance that your income pays back.} other {The store refunded # purchases, so what they gave was taken back. Anything already spent shows as a negative balance that your income pays back.}}
purchase.refunded.text: {n, plural, =1 {商店退还了一笔购买，因此它带来的物品已被收回。已经花掉的部分会显示为负余额，由你的收入逐步还清。} other {商店退还了 # 笔购买，因此它们带来的物品已被收回。已经花掉的部分会显示为负余额，由你的收入逐步还清。}}

purchase.reinstated.en: {n, plural, one {A refund was reversed: your purchase is back.} other {# refunds were reversed: your purchases are back.}}
purchase.reinstated.text: {n, plural, =1 {一笔退款已被撤销：你的购买恢复了。} other {# 笔退款已被撤销：你的购买恢复了。}}

store.withdrawalStipend.en: Delivery starts at once: the first payment can be claimed now and one more each day; by buying you agree that you lose the right to cancel, as the law allows for digital content.
store.withdrawalStipend.text: 立即开始发放：第一次发放现在即可领取，之后每天一次；购买即表示你同意放弃取消的权利，这是法律对数字内容所允许的。

store.error.cancelled.text: 购买已取消，未产生任何扣费。

store.error.unavailable.en: Purchases are not available right now. Try again later.
store.error.unavailable.text: 目前无法购买，请稍后再试。

store.error.failed.en: The purchase did not go through. If you were charged, it is delivered as soon as the store confirms it.
store.error.failed.text: 购买没有成功。如果已经扣费，商店确认后会立即发放。

raid.rejected.defender_protected.text: 那座村庄已经有护盾了。

raid.rejected.no_warriors.en: No warriors fought, so it counts as practice.
raid.rejected.no_warriors.text: 没有战士参战，因此算作练习。

temper.intro.en: Shape every {building} at once. Reach shoots farther but hits softer and goes for back-line warriors first; Blast hits groups but fires slower; Watch makes the Sky Bow Tower, the Bitter Smoke Brazier and traps stronger. Raiders see the shape when they scout.
temper.intro.text: 一次性调整所有{building}的形态。射程：射得更远但伤害更低，并优先攻击后排战士；爆破：能打中成群的战士，但射速更慢；警戒：让天弓塔、苦烟火盆和陷阱更强。突袭者侦察时能看到这些形态。

temper.locked.text: 天守阁 {level} 级开放淬炼。

temper.left.en: {n, plural, one {# point left} other {# points left}}

temper.done.en: Tempered: every {building} has its new shape.
temper.done.text: 淬炼完成：所有{building}都有了新形态。

temper.watchSupport.en: Watch also weakens the raiders' healing, revives, toughness and shield cover across the whole base.
temper.watchSupport.text: 警戒还会在整个基地削弱进攻方的治疗、复活、韧性和护盾掩护。

scout.profile.text: 已淬炼：射程 {reach} · 爆破 {blast} · 警戒 {watch}

stake.help.en: Declare a result before you attack: reach it and carry more loot home, miss it and carry none.
stake.help.text: 进攻前先宣布一个结果：达成就能带回更多战利品，没达成则一无所获。

stake.met.text: 赌注达成：{stars}★，带回 ×{mult} 的战利品。

stake.missed.en: Stake missed: you declared {stars}★, so no loot came home.
stake.missed.text: 赌注未达成：你宣布了 {stars}★，所以没有带回任何战利品。

carry.diversity.en: Your squad carried {pct} of the loot. Squads of more roles carry more.
carry.diversity.text: 你的小队带回了 {pct} 的战利品。职能越多样的小队带回的越多。

raid.rejected.account_deleted.text: 你的在线账号已被删除。

raid.rejected.conflict.en: The opponent changed at the same moment.
raid.rejected.conflict.text: 对手在同一时刻发生了变化。

raid.rejected.version_mismatch.en: This version of the game is too old.

ledger.refundReversed.text: 退款已撤销，购买已归还

res.debt.en: You owe {amount} {resource} from a refunded purchase. It is paid back from your future income; nothing else is taken.
res.debt.text: 你因一笔已退款的购买欠下 {amount} {resource}。它会由你今后的收入逐步还清，不会扣除其他东西。

sync.refused.en: {n, plural, one {The server refused # action because your village had changed, for example on another device. The village on the server is the one kept.} other {The server refused # actions because your village had changed, for example on another device. The village on the server is the one kept.}}
sync.refused.text: {n, plural, other {服务器拒绝了 # 个操作，因为你的村庄已经变了（例如在另一台设备上）。保留的是服务器上的村庄。}}

news.offline.en: Messages from the game's operators arrive when you play online.
news.offline.text: 在线游戏时会收到游戏运营方的消息。

account.signOutDevice.note.en: Finished playing on this phone or browser? Sign it out. Your online account stays for your other devices and linked sign-ins.
account.signOutDevice.note.text: 不再用这部手机或这个浏览器玩了？让它退出登录。你的在线账号会保留给你的其他设备和已关联的登录方式。

account.signOutDevice.body.en: Online play turns off here and this device forgets its key to your online account. The village on this device stays. To play the account here again, sign in with a linked Apple, Google or Game Center account.
account.signOutDevice.body.text: 此设备将关闭在线游戏，并忘记你在线账号的密钥。此设备上的村庄会保留。想在这里再玩这个账号，请用已关联的 Apple、Google 或 Game Center 账号登录。

account.signOutDevice.done.en: This device is signed out. Online play is off here.
account.signOutDevice.done.text: 此设备已退出登录。这里的在线游戏已关闭。

account.signOutDevice.lastKey.en: Not signed out: this device holds the only key to your online account. Link Apple, Google or Game Center first, or delete the account instead.
account.signOutDevice.lastKey.text: 未退出登录：此设备持有你在线账号的唯一密钥。请先关联 Apple、Google 或 Game Center，或者删除账号。

news.reason.resources.en: There were not enough resources in your village on the server.
news.reason.resources.text: 服务器上你村庄的资源不够。

news.reason.maxLevel.en: It was already at its highest level.

news.reason.gone.en: It was no longer in your village.
news.reason.gone.text: 它已经不在你的村庄里了。

news.reason.busy.en: It was already being worked on.

news.reason.limit.en: The limit for it was already reached.

news.reason.changed.en: Your village had already changed, for example on another device.
news.reason.changed.text: 你的村庄已经变了，例如在另一台设备上。

refusal.storageFullRefund.en: Storage is too full: cancelling now would lose {lost} of the {refund} you would get back. Make room first.
refusal.storageFullRefund.text: 仓库太满了：现在取消会损失应退还的 {refund} 中的 {lost}。请先腾出空间。

league.boardOnline.en: The leaderboards are part of online play.
league.boardOnline.text: 排行榜属于在线游戏功能。

sheet.raidRule.en: Raiders can take {pct} of what your storages hold, never more than {cap} of each resource while your Keep is level {level}, and {collectors} of what your collectors have not collected yet.
sheet.raidRule.text: 袭击者可以抢走仓库存量的 {pct}，在天守阁为 {level} 级时每种资源最多 {cap}；还可以抢走生产建筑中你尚未收取部分的 {collectors}。

sheet.collectorPause.en: It produces nothing while it upgrades ({time}). What it holds now stays and can still be collected.
sheet.collectorPause.text: 升级期间（{time}）不会生产。现在存着的资源会保留，仍然可以收取。

unlock.title.en: {n, plural, one {New warrior unlocked!} other {New warriors unlocked!}}

tutorial.end.daily.en: Your first daily chest is ready: Finish opens it.
tutorial.end.daily.text: 你的第一个每日宝箱可以领取了：点“完成”就会打开它。

panel.loadFailed.en: This could not open. Check your connection and try again.
panel.loadFailed.text: 无法打开。请检查网络连接后重试。

panel.staleChunk.en: A newer version of Kagemura is out. Reload to open this.
panel.staleChunk.text: Kagemura 有新版本。请重新加载后再打开。

quality.slowBattles.en: This phone drew battles slowly, so Kagemura will use lighter graphics from the next start. You can change it in Settings → Graphics.
quality.slowBattles.text: 这部手机绘制战斗较慢，因此从下次启动起，Kagemura 将使用更轻量的画面。你可以在“设置 → 画质”中更改。

events.calendar.server.en: Schedule sent by the game's server. Every countdown is real.
events.calendar.server.text: 日程由游戏服务器发送。每个倒计时都是真实的。

events.calendar.builtIn.en: Built-in schedule. Every countdown is real.
events.calendar.builtIn.text: 内置日程。每个倒计时都是真实的。

growth.invite.rule.en: When a friend who started with your friend code reaches Keep {keep} with their village on the server, you each get a fixed reward. Nothing random and nothing to buy.
growth.invite.rule.text: 用你的好友码开始游戏的好友，在服务器上的村庄达到天守阁 {keep} 级时，你们各得一份固定奖励。没有随机内容，也不用购买任何东西。

growth.invite.reward.en: Reward for each of you: {jade} Jade

growth.invite.cap.en: {cap, plural, one {Rewards for up to # friend a month.} other {Rewards for up to # friends a month.}}
growth.invite.cap.text: {cap, plural, other {每月最多为 # 位好友领取奖励。}}

growth.invite.counts.en: Friends who joined with your code: waiting {waiting}, ready {ready}, rewarded {rewarded}
growth.invite.counts.text: 用你的好友码加入的好友：等待中 {waiting}，可领取 {ready}，已奖励 {rewarded}

growth.invite.mine.waiting.en: You joined with a friend's code. Reach Keep {keep} with your village on the server and you both get the reward.
growth.invite.mine.waiting.text: 你是用好友码加入的。让服务器上的村庄达到天守阁 {keep} 级，你们两人都能获得奖励。

growth.invite.mine.ready.en: You joined with a friend's code and reached Keep {keep}: your reward is ready.
growth.invite.mine.ready.text: 你是用好友码加入的，并已达到天守阁 {keep} 级：你的奖励可以领取了。

growth.invite.mine.rewarded.en: You joined with a friend's code and collected your reward.
growth.invite.mine.rewarded.text: 你是用好友码加入的，已经领取了奖励。

growth.invite.needsServer.en: Rewards go to a village on the server. Move your village there in Settings → Online play.
growth.invite.needsServer.text: 奖励会发放到服务器上的村庄。请在设置 → 在线游戏中把村庄移到服务器。

growth.invite.nothing.text: 暂时没有可领取的奖励。

growth.invite.enterHint.en: {days, plural, one {Enter their friend code within # day of starting online play.} other {Enter their friend code within # days of starting online play.}}
growth.invite.enterHint.text: {days, plural, other {请在开始在线游戏后 # 天内输入好友码。}}

growth.share.explain.en: {days, plural, one {The server checks this replay and keeps it for # day under a code. Anyone with the link can watch it. The base is shown without its name and your opponent is never named.} other {The server checks this replay and keeps it for # days under a code. Anyone with the link can watch it. The base is shown without its name and your opponent is never named.}}
growth.share.explain.text: 服务器会检查这段回放，并用一个代码保存 {days, plural, other {# 天}}。任何拿到链接的人都能观看。基地不显示名称，你的对手也不会被提及姓名。

growth.share.minor.en: Your name is not shown on replays shared by players under 18.
growth.share.minor.text: 未满 18 岁的玩家分享的回放不会显示名字。

growth.viewer.player.text: 对手是真实玩家的基地。

growth.viewer.generated.en: Against a generated base (made by the computer).
growth.viewer.generated.text: 对手是生成的基地（由电脑制作）。

growth.viewer.failed.en: This shared replay could not be opened.
growth.viewer.failed.text: 无法打开这段分享的回放。

growth.viewer.older.en: This replay was recorded under other battle rules, so this version of the game cannot show it.
growth.viewer.older.text: 这段回放是在其他战斗规则下录制的，此版本的游戏无法显示。

alliance.banner.next.text: 同盟等级 {level} 时获得下一面旗帜。

alliance.banner.note.en: Banners only change how the Alliance looks: no advantage in battle or resources.
alliance.banner.note.text: 旗帜只改变同盟的外观：在战斗和资源上没有任何优势。

stats.tzNote.en: It also sends your time zone's offset from UTC, so days are counted on your own calendar.
stats.tzNote.text: 还会发送你所在时区与 UTC 的时差，以便按你自己的日历计算天数。

preview.notLive.en: Preview: this is not in the live game yet.
preview.notLive.text: 预览：这还不在正式游戏中。

heroPick.intro.en: Choose the hero who joins your attacks.
heroPick.intro.text: 选择加入你进攻的英雄。

heroPick.none.en: No hero can join yet. Heroes join from higher Keep levels.
heroPick.none.text: 目前还没有英雄可以加入。英雄会在天守阁等级更高时加入。

heroPick.joining.text: 加入你进攻的英雄：{hero}，{level} 级

mastery.none.en: Attack with your warriors to earn mastery.
mastery.none.text: 派你的战士进攻来获得精通经验。

terms.body.en: The terms of service for Kagemura came into force on {date}. Please read them and accept them to play online. Your village keeps working on this device either way.
terms.body.text: Kagemura 的服务条款已于 {date} 生效。请阅读并接受条款后再进行在线游戏。无论如何，你的村庄都会继续在这台设备上运行。

consent.apple.label.en: Help Apple decide refund requests (off until you turn it on)
consent.apple.label.text: 帮助 Apple 处理退款申请（你打开前一直关闭）

consent.apple.detail.en: When you ask Apple for a refund, Apple may ask us about the purchase. With this on, we tell Apple that it was delivered and give ranges for how old your account is and how much you have bought and been refunded. Never your name, village or chat. We never ask Apple to refuse a refund.
consent.apple.detail.text: 你向 Apple 申请退款时，Apple 可能会向我们询问这笔购买。打开后，我们会告诉 Apple 购买已交付，并提供你的账户时长以及购买和退款金额的范围。绝不包括你的名字、村庄或聊天。我们绝不会要求 Apple 拒绝退款。

significantUpdate.description.en: This update changes how Kagemura works. A parent or guardian can review it before it is used.
significantUpdate.description.text: 此更新改变了 Kagemura 的运作方式。家长或监护人可以在使用前查看。
